Question
========
Which of the following statements about sustainability strategies are correct?
(More than one statement may be correct.)

Answerlist
----------
* Efficiency aims to use fewer resources per unit of output.
* Consistency means producing goods that can be recycled infinitely.
* Sufficiency encourages higher production levels.
* All three sustainability strategies have the same effect on consumption.


Solution
========
Efficiency focuses on reducing resource use per unit of output. Consistency aims at aligning production with natural cycles, for example through closed-loop or infinitely recyclable systems. Sufficiency questions levels of production and consumption, and the three strategies therefore differ in how they affect consumption.

Answerlist
----------
* True
* True
* False
* False
